description: This Scala source file defines a utility object V2TableRefreshUtil for refreshing table metadata in Spark SQL's data source v2 framework. It includes methods for reloading table info, validating schema and metadata consistency, and handling catalog interactions.

classes.name: V2TableRefreshUtil
classes.description: A utility object providing methods to refresh and validate table metadata in Spark SQL's data source v2 framework.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Main method to refresh table metadata in a logical plan, with optional schema validation mode.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Overloaded method that performs refresh with specified schema validation mode.

methods.name: lookupCachedRelation
methods.description: Looks up a cached relation for a given catalog, identifier, and table.

methods.name: determineSchemaValidationMode
methods.description: Determines schema validation mode based on whether the plan contains commands.

methods.name: containsCommand
methods.description: Checks if the logical plan contains any command nodes.

methods.name: validateTableIdentity
methods.description: Validates that the table ID has not changed after refresh.

methods.name: validateDataColumns
methods.description: Validates that data columns match between current table and relation.

methods.name: validateMetadataColumns
methods.description: Validates that metadata columns are consistent.
